::: {#def-rmse}
#### Root mean squared error

The **population root mean squared error (pRMSE)** of an estimator $\hparam$,
also called its **root mean squared error**,
is the square root of its [pMSE](#def-mse):

$$\pRMSE{\hparam} \eqdef \sqrt{\pMSE{\hparam}}$$

Source: @wikipedia_root_mean_square_deviation.
:::
